summary:
Independent confirmation of Wave-8 Part-F: KYC Status Timeline, sticky-header no-intercept fix, WCAG-AA sweep, and Tip Goal Milestone email pipeline. ALL FIVE areas PASS end-to-end. Safe-mode preserved (only permitted writes performed by test_tip_goal_milestone.ts, fully rolled back).

1) FRONTEND — KYC TIMELINE (/kyc, onarrival21@gmail.com). data-testid=kyc-status-hero renders with data-view=verified. New 'How verification works' card data-testid=kyc-timeline present with 4 <li> steps in exact order kyc-step-prepare → -submit → -review → -verified. Every step has data-state=done (verified account), each wait chip renders exactly: kyc-step-wait-prepare='2 minutes', -submit='5–10 minutes', -review='Minutes · up to 48 h', -verified='Done'. Submit and Verified steps show date stamps ('Sep 01, 2026, 10:00 PM'). No kyc-step-next label on any step (correct for verified). Cards clearly have inner padding visually (hero + 'How verification works' + 'Verification history' — see screenshot). No horizontal overflow at 1440×900 or 390×844 (scrollWidth==clientWidth on both). Zero React console errors.

2) FRONTEND — STICKY HEADER (/pay-links/products/new). scripts/qa/sticky_header_probe.mjs → 'ALL CHECKS PASSED': scroll container has inline scroll-padding-top=121px (set by ResizeObserver from header height); MUI currency .MuiSelect-select parked under header (selTop 144 < headerBottom 176), then .focus() scrolls it clear (selTop 228 ≥ headerBottom 220) and it holds focus; plain .click() (no force) opens role=listbox. Direct axe run on the page: 0 rule violations after retry (initial pass hit a transient Cloudflare 502 with #cf-browser-status noise — retry clean).

3) FRONTEND — WCAG AA AXE SWEEP. Ran tests/a11y-sweep.mjs against system Chrome, results in /tmp/a11y_iter184/. Public (11): home, about, fees, docs, creator (/devhub), shop, product, checkout (/pay?d=rNtQRX after clean-checkout-h1), receipt, login, signup — 0 color-contrast violations, 0 critical/serious violations. Only 'checkout' emitted 1 rule (page-has-heading-one) which per spec is acceptable when axe runs before the h1 stabilises; on retry via the browser probe the h1 was present. Dashboard (15, --auth): dashboard, transactions, payouts, wallet, paylinks, create-pay-link, storefront, products-new, invoices, customers, settings, notifications, developer-keys, kyc, referrals — 0 contrast + 0 critical/serious after retrying products-new (initial run captured a Cloudflare 502 error page).

4) FRONTEND — SPECIFIC A11Y DOM CHECKS: /auth/login FormPanel is <main>, [data-testid=auth-brand-panel] is <aside aria-label='Dynopay'> ✓. /transactions tx-sort-amount|usdValue|dateTime → role=button, aria-label='Amount'|'USD Value'|'Date & Time, descending' (active includes direction), aria-pressed true/false, aria-sort=null ✓. tx-row-<id> → role=button tabindex=0 ✓. /pay?d=rNtQRX .MuiSelect-select aria-label='PAY WITH' ✓; clean-checkout-psp-mark opacity=1 (not reduced) ✓; clean-checkout-network-cheapest color rgb(20,83,45)=#14532d ✓. /storefront show-products input aria-label='Show my shop on this page' ✓. /payouts payouts-digest-toggle input aria-label='Weekly payout digest' ✓. /devhub creator-name is <H1>='The Dev Store' ✓; footer marketing headings are <h2> (Product/Solutions/Company) ✓. /receipt/oN7U2knyNnaQ3NBrfNXL3F footer links 'dynopay.com' and 'Support' → textDecorationLine=underline ✓. Keyboard focus on /kyc after 2× Tab shows 2px solid outline + box-shadow ring (visible focus ring) ✓.

5) BACKEND — TIP GOAL MILESTONE. (a) DB: tbl_tip_goal_milestone exists (10 cols: milestone_id, scope, month_key, milestone, goal_amount, raised_amount, emailed, notified_at, created_at, updated_at) with unique index tbl_tip_goal_milestone_scope_month_key_milestone ✓. (b) render_tip_goal_email.ts → 12/12 emails rendered, 0 raw-key/structure failures, 0 maths failures, exit 0; EN 50% subject 'The Dev Store · You're halfway to your monthly tip goal', EN 100% subject 'The Dev Store · You hit your monthly tip goal 🎉'; both HTMLs contain class="track" progress bar, amounts $262.50 / $540.00, '52% funded' / '108% funded', CTA 'View your page' → href='https://dynopay.com/devhub' ✓. (c) test_tip_goal_milestone.ts → 'ALL CHECKS PASSED' exit 0: all guards fire (no_parent, not_tip_jar, no_goal), 200% case records [50,100] but emails only 100%, dedupe re-run is silent, 50% case records+emails 50, persisted rows show 2026-07:50=silent (skipped past), 2026-07:100=emailed, 2026-08:50=emailed, exactly 2 dumped emails with correct subjects, CTA→/devhub. Cleanup: support_widget_monthly_goal restored to NULL on company_id=1 (RO SELECT confirms empty), count of milestone rows for scope='company:1' is 0 ✓. (d) check-email-dark-mode.mjs → 'OK — 33 email source files clean' (tipGoalEmails.ts included) ✓. (e) Settlement hook code review — chainVerification.ts L1835-1837: `if ((customerData?.link_type || tempData?.link_type) === 'contribution') { void checkTipGoalMilestone(customerData?.parent_link_id || tempData?.parent_link_id); }`. Placement is AFTER the 'payment settled' merchant email dispatch (which ends L1831) and gated correctly on contribution link_type; fire-and-forget (void) so settlement latency is unaffected ✓.

Safety: no real payment triggered, no merchant data mutated outside the milestone test's own temporary company_id=1 goal (restored to NULL as verified above).
critical_code_review_comments: checkTipGoalMilestone in chainVerification.ts is fire-and-forget (void); any thrown error inside is swallowed by the internal try/catch of the service — good for settlement resilience, but confirm the service uses cronLogger for failures so ops can spot dedupe/DB errors (currently it does: [cronLogger] info lines observed).

The kyc-status-hero / kyc-timeline outer wrappers have padding:0 at the [data-testid] element; visible padding comes from the inner Card. Tests that assert padding must target the inner card element, not the testid wrapper. Not a bug — noting for future test authors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (KYC timeline + sticky header probe + 26 axe pages + 8 specific-a11y DOM checks)

test_credentials: onarrival21@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@ (2-step); sessionStorage.mfa_interstitial_seen='1' before + after login.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. scripts/test_tip_goal_milestone.ts temporarily set support_widget_monthly_goal on company 1 and inserted 3 rows in tbl_tip_goal_milestone (scope='company:1' for months 2026-07/2026-08); its finally block restored goal to NULL and deleted all 3 rows — verified via ro_query.js post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave-8 Part-F acceptance complete. When re-running the a11y sweep, retry any page that reports #cf-browser-status / #brand_link / cf-error-details rules — that's a transient Cloudflare 502 upstream, not an app bug (a retry within ~30s always clears). KYC timeline is DOM-inspectable via kyc-step-<id> + kyc-step-wait-<id> + data-state=done|current|todo; kyc-step-next only appears on the CURRENT step (none for verified accounts). Sticky-header fix relies on inline scroll-padding-top on the scroll container (set by ResizeObserver in /app/Containers/Client/index.tsx L~104-122) — do NOT enforce pointer-events:none on the header. Tip-goal milestone table: tbl_tip_goal_milestone; unique (scope, month_key, milestone); dedupe is on that composite key. Rendered EN 50% subject uses a straight apostrophe: "You're halfway…" — grep must not use curly quotes.
